from urllib.request import urlopen

base='https://open-bubble-tank.vercel.app'

with urlopen(urljoin(base,href),timeout=30) as r: icon=r.read();istatus=r.status;itype=r.headers.get('Content-Type')
assert status==200 and istatus==200 and 'image/svg+xml' in itype
assert 'Play with mock assets' in text and 'Bubble Tanks 3' in text
